title: CLI — parse & dispatch
overview: The command-line entry layer, before the build pipeline runs: read argv, accept only the `build` command, collect `--src`/`--out` overrides, then hand off to build(overrides) and map a rejected build to a non-zero exit. A separate concern from the pipeline itself — hence its own category.

nodes.label: mdsite [args]
description: Process entry: the bin script runs with argv.

nodes.label: Read argv → cmd
description: Slice process.argv; the first positional is the command, defaulting to 'build'.

nodes.label: cmd === 'build'?
description: Only 'build' is supported in this minimal CLI.

nodes.label: Print usage → exit 1
description: Unknown command: write the usage line to stderr and exit non-zero.

nodes.label: Collect --src / --out
description: Read optional --src and --out flags and fold the present ones into an overrides object (later layered over config defaults).

nodes.label: build(overrides)
description: Hand off to the build pipeline with the collected overrides. The CLI awaits its promise.

nodes.label: Build failed → exit 1
description: A rejected build is caught: print the message to stderr and exit non-zero.

nodes.label: Site built
description: The build promise resolved — the process exits 0.
